summary: Adds GET /api/labels/used?object_type=<str> to LabelEngine, returning all distinct labels currently attached to at least one object of the given type.

classification.why_platform: Reverse-lookup of labels by object_type is a generic, reusable capability over the labels.object_labels join table — it encodes no application-specific business logic or domain meaning.
non_goals: Filtering by label name within results

consumes: labels.object_labels table (label_id, object_type) — ix_object_labels_object_type index already exists
provides: GET /api/labels/used?object_type=<str> — returns LabelSearchResponse: { labels: [{ id, name }] } ordered by name ASC
Returns 422 with code OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED when object_type is absent or blank
Returns empty list (not 404) when no labels are attached to any object of the given type
invariants: Only labels with at least one row in object_labels for the given object_type are returned
Results are ordered by lower(name) ascending
object_type comparison is case-sensitive (stored lowercase per DB CHECK constraint)
failure_modes: OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED (422): object_type query param is absent or blank after strip
Database connectivity failure propagates as 500 (unhandled — consistent with existing routes)

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/labels/used
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return all distinct labels attached to at least one object of the given object_type, ordered by name ASC

exposed_surfaces.name: LabelService.get_labels_used_by_type
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Execute the distinct join query and return list[LabelRecord] ordered by name

internal_flow.name: validate_object_type
internal_flow.description: Router receives GET /api/labels/used. Strip object_type query param. If absent or blank after strip, return 422 ApiError with code OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED.

internal_flow.name: execute_reverse_lookup
internal_flow.description: Call LabelService.get_labels_used_by_type(conn, object_type). Execute: SELECT DISTINCT l.id, l.name FROM labels.labels l JOIN labels.object_labels ol ON ol.label_id = l.id WHERE ol.object_type = %s ORDER BY lower(l.name). Uses ix_object_labels_object_type index.

internal_flow.name: return_response
internal_flow.description: Wrap result in LabelSearchResponse and return 200. Empty list returns normally — no 404.

internal_required.role: get_db context manager for psycopg2 connection
LabelRecord, LabelSearchResponse — already defined, no changes needed
LabelService — new method get_labels_used_by_type added here

forbidden: No new files — all changes are additions to existing files
